player_0.content: New plan: I failed the task because the generated resume contained multiple commas (e.g., in the contact info, summary, and bullet points). My strategy was to write natural sentences without monitoring the punctuation constraint. Next time, I will draft the content first, then systematically scan every line for commas and replace them with periods, semicolons, or rephrased clauses. I will also ensure that lists use line breaks instead of commas to separate items, and I will verify the final output against the "no commas" rule before submitting.
